description: Deletes a product for good. Owner only. Refused with product_in_use while an app setting points at it, and with product_has_subscribers while users subscribe to it, unless force: true. Past sales stay: refund them first with neblla_sales. More: neblla_get_llms tools/delete_product

force.description: true unlinks those settings and ends the subscriptions at the end of the paid period (no more charges, no refund).

name: neblla_delete_product
title: Delete a product
